name.fr-FR: Opuscules de saint François de Sales, tome XXIV
name.en-US: Opuscules of St. Francis de Sales, vol. XXIV
name.pt-BR: Opúsculos de São Francisco de Sales, tomo XXIV

description.fr-FR: Les opuscules du tome XXIV de l’édition d’Annecy : l’administration épiscopale (ordonnances, synodes diocésains, patentes), pour l’essentiel des pièces administratives et juridiques.
description.en-US: The opuscules in volume XXIV of the Annecy edition: the episcopal administration (ordinances, diocesan synods, patents), mostly short administrative and legal documents.
description.pt-BR: Os opúsculos de São Francisco de Sales no tomo XXIV da edição de Annecy (Quatrième série (suite)).

sources.edition: Œuvres de saint François de Sales, édition complète d’après les autographes et les éditions originales, t. XXIV: Opuscules, 1927 (file 24), Annecy: J. Niérat, 1892-1932. Scans with text layer (2022 re-OCR) from donboscosanto.eu.
sources.description: Francis’s text in the original spelling (and the Latin or Italian of some pieces), extracted from the PDF text layer (layout mode). Marginal references, the variants and footnotes, and the editors’ introductions and tables are not included. Chapters follow the printed section headings; short sections are folded into the preceding chapter under a second-level heading.
sources.tierEvidence: Francis died in 1622; the Annecy edition is of his own text in period spelling, published in or before 1932. Only Francis’s own text is used, not the editors’ apparatus.
